data.transcript: To do this, first film a video of you arranging your bread of choice and adding different toppings onto it. Then open the Filmora app on your desktop. Next import your clip into the timeline. Cut the video when you are adding a topping so it becomes stop motion. Now using the pen tool trace the topping and use the dropper to change the color. When that's done go back to the timeline, move the pen clip to before the topping is shown. Then, go to the start of the clip and add a keyframe of trim path at 0% for both start and end points. Finally, add another keyframe at the endpoint of this pen clip for 100%. Just like that, there you have it. Try this out on Filmora.

data.transcript: This is called the clone effect. To make it, you'll only need a few shots of yourself recorded on a tripod. Bring your clips into Filmora and place your first shot on top of your base clip. Then go to AI matting, smart cutout, make a simple selection around yourself and hit apply. Repeat the same process with the rest of your clips. Next make a two-frame cut on all of the clips. Select them all, go to Curves and bring the Brightness channel all the way up! Finally spread each clip 2 frames apart from one another and you're done!! Download Filmora and give it a try.
